sources.snippet: Hi-DiT bridges latent-space and pixel-space diffusion in a single Diffusion Transformer. The latent stream provides efficient semantic planning in a compact VAE latent space, while a time-gated pixel stream is activated in the low-noise regime to recover high-frequency details. This hybrid design keeps the optimization stability of latent diffusion while retaining direct access to pixel-level ...
